summary: The agent formulates a reasonable position-by-position Ridge regression baseline, extracting local sequence features and correctly splitting the data for validation. However, the final submission construction critically fails by overwriting the true test IDs with an arbitrary integer sequence, which will break the evaluation process. Additionally, only a single metric is computed during validation.
